reason: Baris transaksi buku besar mentah (untuk Zahir Ledger Viewer) + no faktur pajak & no invoice
name: bb_trx
query:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT G1.* FROM (
    SELECT
      g.tanggal::date AS d,
      jv.account_id,
      k.code AS account_code,
      jv.department_id,
      jv.project_id,
      jv.cost_code_id,
      g.contact_id,
      g.currency_id,
      g.id  AS transaction_id,
      jv.id AS jurnal_id,
      g.type,
      g.nojurnal,
      g.keterangan,
      COALESCE(jv.debit, 0)::numeric  AS debit,
      COALESCE(jv.kredit, 0)::numeric AS kredit
    FROM g_jurnal g
    JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id
    JOIN kiraan k    ON k.id = jv.account_id
    WHERE g.status = 'approved'
  ) G1
  WHERE 1=1 {andWhere}
),
fp AS (
  SELECT o.data_id, string_agg(o.value, ', ') AS value
  FROM other_fields o
  WHERE o."key" = '9' AND o.data_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT transaction_id FROM f)
  GROUP BY o.data_id
),
ir AS (
  SELECT sb.child_id AS data_id, string_agg(gi.nojurnal, ', ' ORDER BY gi.tanggal, gi.nojurnal) AS no_invoice
  FROM subsider sb
  JOIN g_jurnal gi ON gi.id = sb.parent_id
  WHERE sb.child_id <> sb.parent_id AND sb.child_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT transaction_id FROM f)
  GROUP BY sb.child_id
),
hasil AS (
  SELECT
    f.account_id,
    f.account_code                AS kode_akun,
    k.nama                        AS nama_akun,
    k2.noklasifikasi,
    f.d                           AS tanggal,
    f.type                        AS tipe,
    f.nojurnal                    AS referensi,
    f.jurnal_id,
    COALESCE(c.perusahaan, '')    AS kontak,
    COALESCE(f.keterangan, '')    AS deskripsi,
    COALESCE(d.nama, '')          AS dept,
    COALESCE(p.namapekerjaan, '') AS proyek,
    COALESCE(fp.value, '')        AS faktur_pajak,
    COALESCE(ir.no_invoice, '')   AS no_invoice,
    f.debit,
    f.kredit
  FROM f
  JOIN kiraan k      ON k.id = f.account_id
  JOIN subklas s     ON s.id = k.subclassification_id
  JOIN klas k2       ON k2.id = s.classification_id
  LEFT JOIN cardfile c ON c.contact_id = f.contact_id
  LEFT JOIN dept d     ON d.id = f.department_id
  LEFT JOIN job p      ON p.project_id = f.project_id
  LEFT JOIN fp         ON fp.data_id = f.transaction_id
  LEFT JOIN ir         ON ir.data_id = f.transaction_id
)
SELECT account_id, kode_akun, nama_akun, noklasifikasi, tanggal, tipe, referensi, jurnal_id, kontak, deskripsi, dept, proyek,
       faktur_pajak, no_invoice, debit, kredit
FROM hasil
ORDER BY kode_akun, tanggal, referensi, jurnal_id {andOrder} {limit}
